title: Emile's own old clarinets and offers to repair them
summary: Emile shows his locked case and unused spare clarinet; the interviewer offers to recork and repad it, and Emile says he likes old instruments for tone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
